source.name: The Guardian: 'Women's Super League 2026-27 preview No 5: Charlton Athletic'
source.quote: A record-breaking partnership has seen haircare brand Sofnfree become the women’s team’s official sleeve partner. The branding will feature on all playing and replica shirts

note: Sofnfree is the women's first team's Official Sleeve and Haircare Partner; described by the club as record-breaking for the women's team; value not disclosed.
